definitions.explanation: The larger form of a letter in alphabets that distinguish between two cases, such as A, B, C in the Latin alphabet. Contrasted with {小文字|こもじ} (lowercase).

examples.japanese: {大文字|おおもじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大文字|おおもじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{小文字|こもじ}→小文字：12464_komoji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please mix uppercase and lowercase letters in your password.
In English, the rule is to capitalize the first letter of a sentence.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {大|おお} (large) + ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (character, letter). Primarily used when discussing the Latin alphabet or other writing systems with case distinctions.
The reading おおもじ means uppercase letter. The same kanji can also be read だいもんじ, which refers to the famous Daimonji bonfire on a mountainside in Kyoto during the Obon festival.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大文字|おおもじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{小文字|こもじ}→小文字：12464_komoji⟧ (uppercase and lowercase)
- {大文字|おおもじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変換|へんかん}する→変換する：09890_henkansuru⟧ (to convert to uppercase)
- {大文字|おおもじ}⟦{小文字|こもじ}→小文字：12464_komoji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}する→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧ (to distinguish between upper and lower case)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小文字|こもじ}→小文字：12464_komoji⟧: lowercase letter — the smaller form of a letter
